verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that programmatic access requires an access token (docs-17) and that RBAC appears as a pricing-tier feature (docs-29). Neither documents issuing API credentials limited by scope or least privilege, for agents or anyone else. RBAC for workspace users is a related control, not scoped API credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
